# Cardly

Cardly helps businesses create great engagement with customers by getting out of inboxes and into mailboxes.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cardly/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact List**: Add a new contact list.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook subscription.
- **Delete Invitation by Email**: Delete an invitation by email address.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook.
- **Generate Preview** (read-only): Generate a low-quality, watermarked preview document for a card.
- **List Artwork** (read-only): Retrieve the currently available artwork for your organisation.
- **List Credit History** (read-only): List credit history records.
- **List Fonts** (read-only): List your currently available fonts.
- **List Gift Credit History** (read-only): List gift credit history records for your organization.
- **List Invitations** (read-only): Retrieve active invitations for your organisation with optional filters.
- **List Media** (read-only): Retrieve the currently available media sizes for product artwork.
- **List Orders** (read-only): Retrieve orders placed by your organisation.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Retrieve your currently available templates from cardly.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve all users associated with your account.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve any active or disabled webhooks set up for your organisation.
- **List Writing Styles** (read-only): List available writing styles.
- **Retrieve Account Balance** (read-only): Retrieve the current account and gift credit balances for your organisation.
- **Retrieve Order** (read-only): Retrieve information on a specific order.
- **Retrieve User** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific user.
- **Update Webhook**: Update a webhook’s settings, including target url and events.
